req.title: Task description optional
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /tasks/ payloads without a description field.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-017 requires that POST /tasks/ accepts payloads without a description field. The schema shows description is Optional[str] with default None in TaskBase/TaskCreate. Tests must cover: (1) positive — omitting description entirely yields HTTP 201 with description=null; (2) negative — omitting the required title field yields HTTP 422; (3) boundary — description field present but explicitly null also yields HTTP 201 with description=null; (4) boundary — description at max length (500 chars) with no description omitted; (5) negative — description exceeding 500 chars is rejected. Each test asserts exact status codes and exact response field values to kill constant-mutation and comparison-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_post_task_without_description_returns_201
preconditions: Database is initialised with pre-loaded rows

trace: R-TASK-017: system shall accept POST /tasks/ payloads without a description field
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///./test_r017_pos.db')
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import engine
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_task_without_description_returns_201():
    payload = {"title": "Task without description"}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert body["title"] == "Task without description"
    assert body["description"] is None
    assert body["completed"] is False

test_post_task_without_description_returns_201()

from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import engine
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_task_without_description_completed_defaults_false():
    payload = {"title": "DT title only"}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["completed"] is False
    assert body["completed"] != True
    assert body["description"] is None
    assert "created_at" in body
    assert body["updated_at"] is None
    assert body["title"] == "DT title only"
